ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $\triangle ABC$, $AB = AC = 10$. Point $P$ is on $BC$. Parallel lines to $AC$ and $AB$ are drawn through point $P$, intersecting $AB$ and $AC$ at points $M$ and $N$ respectively. What is the perimeter of the quadrilateral $AMPN$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $AB=AC$, \\
it follows that $\angle B=\angle C$, \\
Since $PM\parallel AC$ and $PN\parallel AB$, \\
it implies that quadrilateral AMPN is a parallelogram, and $\angle MPB=\angle C$, \\
Hence, $AM=PN$, $MP=AN$, and $\angle B=\angle MPB$, \\
Therefore, $MB=MP$, \\
Consequently, the perimeter of quadrilateral AMPN is $AM+MP+PN+AN=2(AM+MP)=2(AM+MB)=2AB=\boxed{20}$
